text_block_list.text:
"Фудзи Кисэки, whose decision to take on a
huge
challenge has been the talk of the
racing world,
will be running in today's
Takamatsunomiya
Kinen!"
text_block_list.name: Announcer A

text_block_list.text:
"The stands are absolutely packed with
fans who
came to see her participate in
this 1,200-meter

blink-and-you'll-miss-it sprint!"
text_block_list.name: Announcer A

text_block_list.text:
The screen pans over the audience,
many of
whom are holding up Fuji
Kiseki-branded goods
and large banners
to cheer her on.

That's incredible! I can feel how much
they're
rooting for me, even through the
screen!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
They're all smiling so beautifully. I'm
glad they're
enjoying themselves.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: The pressure isn't getting to you, is it?

text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I can't put on a good
performance if I
chicken out now.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I promised to entertain everyone with
the show of
a lifetime, and I intend to do
just that!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
She gestures enthusiastically to make
her point
and accidentally knocks a
paper cup off the
table.

Sorry about that! Thank goodness it was
only a
paper cup!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'd better wipe this up! Where's a towel
when I
need one?!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
She's not usually so clumsy. Something
feels off.
While I'm trying to figure out
what that might
be...

The curtains slowly rise on Фудзи Кисэки's
first senior
race—the Takamatsunomiya
Kinen.
